author: kycrafft
body:
Look I know it was kind of over powered and it was at a low price, but a lot of people enjoyed it. Now if you get 30 points, no one wants to buy it because it sucks. 

There were were some complaints about  how it ruined gameplay, ect. but it actually can level the playing field quite a bit. Imagine you run into 3 people from the other team on the middle island of senex. Instead of fighting them with your sword, just take out your spanky spade and knock 1 or 2 or all 3 of them off the edge. Or what if there is a diamond guy on top of your roof in Teres? It would be suicide to fight him (unless you are really good/luck or he sucks) so ge your spanky spade out. Chances are, if they know what they are doing, they'll back up. If now, hammer away with it. 

You can use it as a rusher to take out a defense or vise versa

Yeah it is OP but it gives all players the ability to kill anyone else  


so my final thoughts:
 Bring back the kb 2 spanky spade (20 points?)
The kb 1 spade can be kept, just make it iron and name it the spanky spade jr. (7 Points)
